in_marathi.name: Ekayavan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of One-Foot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekayavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekayavan is a Sanskrit name that means 'God of One-Foot'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Ganesha, who is often depicted as having only one foot. The name signifies strength, wisdom, and the ability to overcome obstacles.
